title: Chat/changes: add per-row changed_at_counter for correct maxChanges pagination
description: ChatStore::get_changes_since returns ALL chats whenever any counter change occurs — it has no per-row state tracking. Correct maxChanges pagination requires per-row changed_at_counter (same as contacts V8 migration). Needs: V9 migration adding changed_at_counter INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 to chats table + trigger to increment it on UPDATE + get_changes_since_ordered in ChatStore + maxChanges parse+truncation in ChatChangesHandler. This was not addressed in KITH-oo4y.1 which only fixed Message/changes. Message/changes is now correct; Chat/changes remains non-compliant.
